title: Explicit elastic-wave inclusion release contract
purpose: Verify the material-region, source-amplitude, periodic-projection, absorbing-boundary, lumped-mass, and central-difference path used by the public wave-inclusion demo.

execution.evidence: A reduced serial counterpart of the release demo propagates a pulse through a two-material mesh while recording receiver arrival, peak response, Courant number, and periodic mismatch.

observables: Matrix pressure and shear wave speeds and inclusion pressure-wave speed.
Explicit Courant number from the declared mesh, time step, and fastest material.
Peak global and receiver displacement and receiver threshold-arrival time.
Maximum top-bottom periodic projection mismatch over all increments.
acceptance: Every versioned observable satisfies its Golden tolerance.
The receiver detects a nonzero transmitted pulse before the end of the run.

quantities.name: matrix_pressure_wave_speed
quantities.description: Plane-strain pressure-wave speed for E=100, nu=0.25, and density=1.

quantities.name: inclusion_pressure_wave_speed
quantities.description: Pressure-wave speed for the inclusion with twice the matrix Young modulus.

quantities.name: courant_number
quantities.description: Time step times fastest wave speed divided by the minimum cell length.

quantities.name: maximum_displacement
quantities.description: Peak displacement magnitude during the reduced release workflow.

quantities.name: receiver_peak_displacement
quantities.description: Peak displacement in the receiver band after inclusion interaction.

quantities.name: receiver_arrival_time
quantities.description: First sampled time when receiver displacement reaches 1e-6.

limitations: This is a reduced release regression, not a mesh/time-converged external validation.
Receiver arrival is threshold- and time-step-dependent and is versioned accordingly.
The absorbing-boundary reflection coefficient still needs a dedicated convergence benchmark.
